text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Starting today, my trainee and I will be taking on the Twinkle Series. The Umamusume joining me for this journey is none other than…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm Tokai Teio! Nice to meet you!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: So the thing is, I want to be a super tough and cool racer, just like Prez!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: That means I have to win a whole load of races, but you can count on me! Hehehe!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, <chrname> and I take our first steps towards competing in the Twinkle Series!
